title: Bring the radial menu back for the user: Tab opens Gallery / Projects / Flows / Latest workspace
description:
Fabio, 2026-09-18. MPI-378 killed the user radial because the ring had a single item left. Flows and the remembered last card now give it four real destinations, so Tab goes back to being the radial opener and the three-state Tab FLIPPER is retired (one key cannot be both).

Layout, Fabio's call - diagonals, not the cardinal points the renderer computes by default:
- Gallery           top-left
- Projects (landing) bottom-left
- Flows             top-right
- Latest workspace  bottom-right

Latest workspace greys out (disabled, never selectable) when resolveFlipTarget() returns null - no cards, or a remembered card since deleted.

Ctrl+Tab stays the dev radial, minus its Flows item (now a user destination).

Accent: the radial rebinds --accent-heat to --hub-accent (Studio cream, the mascot accent) - DESIGN.md 'The accent family'. A block rebinding --accent-heat MUST restate --accent-heat-hi in the same rule.

Files: js/components/Primitives/MpiRadialMenu/{MpiRadialMenu.js,MpiRadialMenu.css}, js/shell/navigation.js, js/managers/hotkeyRegistry.js.
